card.name: Start of surnames after initials
card.fires_on: The word or word piece right after a first name or initial, where a surname (often Germanic or Nordic) begins, as in citations and credits. It also fires on "this" or "to" in web page prompts like "Sign up to study this" and "Click here to return".

modes.label: Surname beginnings
modes.description: First piece of a European surname after a first name or initial in references or credits.

modes.label: Web page prompts
modes.description: Word in site calls to action such as study this deck or click here to return.
modes.example: Click here<< to>> return to the Zoology Archives Update

card.writes: It pushes toward the continuation of foreign-looking name pieces and celebratory words, while suppressing other name starts.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a person's surname is about to begin in a citation or credit, plus a few web page link phrases.
